common_normal: exact interval-margin gradient at each source replay action, shared across methods
state_regions: 128 states with current static clearance0..20mm above safety threshold;128 above20mm
entropy_definition: per-state Gaussian marginal covariance proxies; H_T is two-dimensional; H_N+H_T not claimed joint entropy
risk_definition: actual next-interval margin minus common replay-action margin, not episode risk
limitations: interim matched policy milestone and replay prefix; full snapshot ages may differ; not a completed directional experiment

resume_lineage.training_violation_counter_scope: restored 190k counter plus new transitions; excludes at least one lost-tail violation and any unlogged violations
resume_lineage.physical_continuation: new physical episodes; learner, optimizer, replay and RNG restored, not bitwise trajectory continuation
resume_lineage.engineering_change: A100 instead of 5080; checkpoints every 1000 instead of 10000 transitions
